description:
Activate Weaver of Currents by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Weaver of Currents.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Weaver of Currents.
Repeat.
